steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada writing test has three tasks: a message (60 to 120 words), a longer text (120 to 150 words) and an opinion (120 to 180 words). Here you practise the building blocks: greetings, sentences, connectors and structure.

steps.title: A model message
steps.body: Task 1 is a short message. Greet, say what you need in one or two clear sentences, thank, and sign.

examples.fr: Salut Marie, je suis malade. Je ne viens pas lundi. Merci ! Karim
examples.en: Hi Marie, I am sick. I am not coming on Monday. Thanks! Karim

steps.prompt: Which greeting starts a message to a friend?
steps.explain: Salut is how you greet a friend.

options: Je m'appelle Karim et je suis vingt ans.
Je appelle Karim et j'ai vingt ans.
Je m'appelles Karim et j'ai vingt ans.
Je m'appelle Karim et j'ai vingt ans.
steps.explain: In French you say j'ai vingt ans (I have twenty years) and je m'appelle.

steps.prompt: How do you end a short message to a friend?
steps.explain: À bientôt means see you soon, a friendly ending.
